intro: Everything is made fresh daily. The savory lunch specials rotate and often sell out, so come early. Prices are posted at the counter — ask at the window for today’s specials.
specialsNote: Check our Facebook page for today’s lunch special.

page.specialsLead: The savory bannock special is different most days.

notes.title: Made fresh daily
notes.body: Bannock is fried to order, and the house-baked cookies and muffins change from day to day.

notes.title: Specials sell out
notes.body: The savory bannock lunch special rotates and often sells out, so come early if you have your heart set on it.

notes.title: Made to go
notes.body: We are a grab-and-go spot: order at the window and take it with you.
